title: National Security Act passed weeks after Roswell

tellings.quote: believe the National Security Act was September 1947 and Roswell was July of 1947.

plain: Jesse Michels points out that the National Security Act of 1947, the law that reorganised the US military and intelligence agencies, came in September 1947, only weeks after Roswell, the reported crash of an unknown craft near Roswell, New Mexico, in July. He says it himself, from memory, to suggest that the new secrecy structure may have been shaped in part by the crash.
